claims.statement: In the fleet02/B19 two-physical-hub collar, with S=sqrt(det(MM^T)), leverages ell_i and transverse leaf heights r_i, put W=sum_i(1-ell_i)r_i^2. For W>0, one literal original-coordinate cut has E3 at least (27/256)S^2W, hence ||p_Q||inf <= 15.349 S^(-1/3)W^(-1/6), with a continuous C0 density.

At the partner scale S>S0=1/(480 sqrt(7626)), W>=2^-20 implies ||p_Q||inf<5375. Every unpaid state therefore has sum_{ell_i<=3/4} r_i^2<2^-18, so the aggregate transverse row residual outside at most two high-leverage leaves is <1/512 in Frobenius norm.

If the low-leverage normalized frame has mu=lambda_min(V0V0^T)>=1/4, then there are a physical diagonal Delta0 and symmetric 2x2 K with ||D[J0,J0]-Delta0-V0^T K V0||F<15/512. If mu<1/4, more than 3/4 of one normalized frame direction is carried by at most two literal high-leverage leaf coordinates.

partner_applied.actual_inequality: Gamma_i^2=S^2(1-ell_i)r_i^2; summing and Bernoulli compiling gives a literal cut with E3 >= (27/256) S^2 sum_i(1-ell_i)r_i^2.

continuity: Proved only on the aggregate physical-E3 payment branch; unrestricted continuity remains open.
